test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 2 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The famous folk musician Bhupen Hazarika belongs to which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Assam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhupen Hazarika**

 
 
• **Bhupen Hazarika** was an Indian playback **singer, lyricist, musician, poet, actor, and filmmaker** from **Assam**, widely known as **Sudha Kontho** means 'nectar-throated.
 
• The songs, based on the themes of **communal amity, universal justice, and empathy,** are especially popular among the people of Assam, West Bengal, and Bangladesh.
 
• He is acknowledged to introduce the culture and folk music of Assam and Northeast India to Hindi cinema at the national level.
 
• He received the **National Film Award** for **Best Music Direction** in 1975, **Padma Shri, and Padma Bhushan**, **Dada Saheb Phalke Award**, the highest award for cinema in India, the **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**, and **Sangeet Natak Akademi Fellowship**, the highest award of the Sangeet Natak Akademi.
 
• In **2012**, he was awarded the **Padma Vibhushan**, India's second-highest civilian award, and in **2019** the **Bharat Ratna**, India's highest civilian award, posthumously.
 
• Bhupen Hazarika also held the position of Chairman of the Sangeet Natak Akademi from December 1998 to December 2003.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **15th** Chief Minister of Assam is **Sri Himanta Biswa Sarma.**
 
• The **31st** Governor of Assam is **Gulab Chand Kataria**.
 
• **Dispur** is the capital of **Assam.**
